card.name: Opening parenthesis after Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease
card.fires_on: Most strongly on the "(" that follows "Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease" and introduces the abbreviation CJD or vCJD. Weaker hits on a few scattered words such as "be" after "should not", "Top" in "Topical", and "an" or "two" before a noun.
